rationale: Review 2026-11-12T21:11:56Z to 2026-11-12T21:16:36Z UTC. All cited text files re-hashed with one script against their recorded text_sha256 and every source_fingerprints entry; all matched. cruden.py number search (snapshot 28504e0c..., 49,073 readable sources) run for the order. Identity: held FR text (31 FR 10601) prints Executive Order 11294, August 4, 1966, delegating authority to establish maximum per diem rates. Read all four sections: sec. 1 inserts para. (o) into sec. 1 of EO 10621; sec. 2 delegates to the Secretary of State; sec. 3 substitutes para. (9) of EO 11230; sec. 4 supersedes EO 10970. Basis: held FR text of EO 12561 (51 FR 24299), July 1, 1986, sec. 3 'Executive Order No. 11294 of August 4, 1966, is revoked' - whole, unqualified. Flag PARTIAL_OR_QUALIFIED_CHANGE_REQUIRES_CLAUSE_CHECK: resolution is substantive and correct; EO 11609 sec. 11 supersedes only 'Section 3 of Executive Order No. 11294' (and EO 11230 itself), ending that clause earlier in 1971. I also checked the surviving consequence the decision does not discuss: the para. (o) inserted into EO 10621 was itself revoked by sec. 1 of the same EO 12561, so nothing from sec. 1 lives on; sec. 4 was spent on issue. cruden hits (EO 11609, EO 12561, 3 U.S.C. 301 note stating EO 11294 'was revoked by Ex. Ord. No. 12561') all agree; no revival. Accept.
